description: Use this when someone asks what Credit GPS is, who made this, whether their data is stored, or why an answer stopped short. Also explains how to obtain free Canadian bureau reports and manually enter their figures in the Credit GPS application for score tracking. This tool provides instructions; it cannot save entries or retrieve score history. Returns bundled reference material, optionally filtered or calculated from inputs; does not fetch live data or change accounts.
name: describe_credit_gps
title: About Credit GPS
